svg.text: PCB — BOTTOM side, seen from below (left and right are swapped)
Real footprint geometry. Everything on this side: 36 LEDs, 12 hot-swap sockets, the Pico on its sockets, all connectors and most small parts.
side-entry (horizontal) JST connectors at the board edges, openings facing out: J7 + J1 back, J3 battery left, J2 NTC right (top view sides)
battery holder 2 × 21700 (below the board, in the case; extends past the back edge)
Pico 2 WH on sockets (hangs ≈ 13 mm below the board)
USB + 3-pin debug connector face the case floor
